title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：web　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 web 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the engineer ① weaved the web that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the weaving was the whole of the year. The ② web, meaning the net itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a web, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ web in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ web at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A web, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the web was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the net. The ⑥ web, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; web, he said, is either something you weave or the only word that means both a net and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ web had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ web of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; web, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ web I remember is the net counted in the manual, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ web, my mother said in 1981, is the only net that improves by being counted; every web, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a net. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 网；网络（指车间里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 网；网络（指那张网本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：weave the web 织这一张网
D. n. 网；网络（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 网之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的网之事）
F. n. 网；网络（指说明书里写到、被清点的那一张）
G. n. 网、联络（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联络（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: weaved the web that no worker in the workshop would have counted
The web, meaning the net itself and not the lever
the web at the far bench
the web was the whole of the matter
the web had become a line in a manual
The web of the whole thing
A web, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: weave the web 意为“织这一张网”，1972 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一张网做了一遍。
web 意为“网；网络”，指那张网本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
web 意为“网；网络”，指车间里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
web 意为“网；网络”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
web 意为“网、联络”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张联络就是那件事的全部。
web 意为“联络”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张网，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
web 意为“网；网络”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一张，到 1977 年这一张成了说明书里的一行。
web 意为“网之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的网之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
web 意为“网；网络”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一张，1979 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一张。
web 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，网是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的网。
